skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals a 4-hit combo to an entire enemy row for 12000% ATK splittable [Specialized Direct DMG] (affected only by advanced DMG modifiers), ignoring 45% [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction], and penetrating [Unyielding] and [Specialized Unyielding]. This damage is not split among targets that cannot be damaged; each splittable target increases the damage by an additional 30%.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: ATK 12000% > 15000%. For each target that can be split, DMG 30% > 40%. Reduces the number of [Resurrection] turns for all enemies by 2 > 3. Reduces the number of [Revenge] turns for all enemies by 5.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently gains +20 Max HP. On entry, gains 60% [Specialized Evasion], and reduces all enemies' [Resurrection] count by 2 and [Non-Critical Hit Invincibility] turns by 4.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Specialized Evasion 70% > 78%. Reduce number of [Non-Critical Hit Invincibility] turns by 4 > 5. Reduces the number of [Revenge] turns for all enemies by 5 > 7.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: When the user's own HP/[Specialized HP] takes damage, that damage is reduced by 60%, and 60% of the original damage converts into [Energy Resilience]. Before any character acts, G5 has a 40% chance to perform a [Charged Pursuit] at 80% skill power (if the front row has no target that can take damage, it pursues the back row instead), up to 2 times per turn. The follow-up chance increases by an additional 40% after each enemy is defeated. ———- [Charged Pursuit]: uses a damage or group-healing Ultimate to pursue random targets, with no energy cost.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Permanently reduces damage taken 60% > 80%. Original damage converted into [Energy Resilience] 60% > 80%. Chance to perform a [Charged Pursuit] 40% > 60%, skill strength 80% > 100%, up to 2 > 3 times per turn.

effects.desc: PvP (advanced) tier of Resilience — shield ignores stronger damage, only penetrated by advanced breakers.
Shield ignores damage from certain attacks. Must be penetrated by Breakthrough or Charge/True DMG.
The revive/return mechanism is tied to the life of the ally, bringing the unit back into the match.
The shield type converts its cumulative value into damage reduction, is limited to a multiple of the unit's maximum Health, and cannot be used with Resurrection.
The counterattack state can extend the duration on yourself or shorten it on enemies, granting retaliatory effects.
